entities.name: The Medieval Period
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The period of European and global history (c. 500-1500 CE) between the fall of Rome and the Renaissance, characterized by feudalism, the Catholic Church's dominance, Islamic Golden Age, Mongol expansion, and the gradual development of institutions — universities, parliaments, banking — that would enable the modern world.
